message: P3-01's sandbox-run protocol has the agent run `make deploy/smoke/destroy`, but the auto-mode permission classifier denies IaC apply, so the task blocks every time and APPROVED is unreachable through the fix loop; only a human operator action (grant permission or run it) can clear it.
kukulu_mutate's targeted `filter` forbids spaces, but node:test names here are sentences; I had to pass regex fragments like `run.tolerates` or `.` (whole suite) to select tests.

kukulu_review_submit refuses CHANGES REQUESTED with no tasks and no unblock, but the skill forbids APPROVED while a task is blocked. With P3-01 blocked by the permission classifier and no code findings, the only accepted submission is unblocking a task the reviewer knows will be denied again.

Round 3 repeats round 2 exactly: no code changed, P3-01 re-blocked by the permission classifier within a minute of being unblocked, and the only submission the tool accepts is unblocking it again. The fix loop has no way to report "awaiting operator" and halt, so it can cycle indefinitely on a blocker only a human can clear.

Round 4 is the third identical cycle: no branch content changed since 5f09618, P3-01 re-blocked by the permission classifier, and the only accepted submission is unblocking it again. Round 3 was already flagged nonConverging; the controller should halt as "awaiting operator" instead of spinning another round.

Round 5 is the fourth identical cycle since 5f09618: no branch content changed, P3-01 re-blocked by the permission classifier denying `make deploy`, and the only submission the tool accepts is unblocking it again. The controller has marked rounds 3 and 4 nonConverging; it should halt as "awaiting operator" instead of spinning another round.
